answer: Run the economy on bilateral credit lines, Ostra-style. Every payment or vote must route along a chain of IOU limits that agents extend only to peers they actually trust, and each hop debits that line until the recipient settles. A sybil nebula of a million fresh keys still sits on one narrow ledge: the few credit lines honest agents granted its operator. Whatever it extracts is capped by that credit and charged to the grantor, who then trims it back like yarrow. Clones multiply names, not borrowing capacity.
